description: S3a's feature fixture (demo-recorder-skirmish-slice.md): two groups of units with fire-starting weapons meet in the densest forest of Two Continents (about 77 trees in the 512-px block at x 2560, z 7168), so trees burn and spread, deaths spawn corpses among the trees, and the explosions of later deaths damage the trees and corpses around them. A construction kbot reclaims a laboratory wreck behind the ARM line, FeatureDie's reclaim root; (1820, 7116) is the only free and level ground near the fight big enough for it. No commanders, so no death ends the level early; scenarios/replay-end.json ends it.
